brandt.description: Nurse Brandt's knowledge/belief as the text states it.

cendre.description: Dr. Cendre's working theory as the text states it.

ground-truth.description: What the narration asserts happened, on every world-line where the carrying scene lies.

helene.description: Hélène Surel's knowledge/belief as the text states it.

confess.description: Fork-2 A (CONFESS): sc-41..45 then sc-56..60; ENDING B (suicide).

confront.description: Fork-1 A (CONFRONT): sc-21..25 then sc-51..55; ENDING A (suicide).

escalate.description: Fork-2 B (ESCALATE): sc-46..50 then sc-61..65; ENDING C (murder by Hélène).

augustin-roeder.description: Dead head physician; ran the secret 'method'; found in locked room.

brown-bottle.description: The unlabelled brown bottle of strong morphia, a third gone.

burial-register.description: The leather-bound book of the dead.

burned-chart.description: The old kept-alive case folder, burned in the stove.

cellar-archive.description: The cellar archive of discharged charts.

dr-cendre.description: Acting/only physician after Roeder's death; investigator.

edvard-lindqvist.description: Stockholm engineer; the second patient; false 'improving' chart; dies on escalate.

forged-admission-papers.description: Hélène's forged admission papers (false Lausanne referral).

gaspard-steward.description: The steward; keeps the keys, the warden's board, the maintenance log.

helene-surel.description: False-name patient ('Madame Surel'); sister of the buried Surel; murderer on the escalate line.

last-telegram.description: The last telegram (Aigle resupply) before the line went dead.

maintenance-log.description: The funicular maintenance log, chained to Gaspard's desk, with a blank day.

master-key.description: House master key on the warden's board in Gaspard's office.

morphine-ledger.description: The green morphine ledger; grains signed out under Roeder's hand.

nurse-brandt.description: Head nurse; keeps the doses; burned a chart; survives all limbs.

resignation-letter.description: Roeder's unsent resignation to the Berne board, halting on 'conscience'.

roeder-method.description: Roeder's secret evening 'method': morphia injections to the favoured cases.

roeder-own-key.description: Roeder's private key, found inside the bolted room.

sanatorium-belvoir.description: The snowed-in sanatorium, former Hôtel Belvoir.

snow-wet-boots.description: Lindqvist's boots, snow-wet and packed at the toe.

stewards-office.description: Gaspard's office with the warden's board.

surel-brother.description: Hélène's brother; a spent method-subject; six years in the house ground.

held_by.description: Physical custody of a trackable object: one holder at a time within a frame and world-line.

life_state.description: alive | dead; transitions only alive -> dead.

b01-line-cut.claim: An avalanche cuts the funicular and the telegraph line; Belvoir is shut for three weeks.
b01-line-cut.quote: a great weight of snow let go of the mountain ... the line was cut

b01-setup-telegram.claim: The evening's last telegram, an Aigle apothecary's promise of morphia and quinine on the first clear funicular, comes up just before the line is cut.
b01-setup-telegram.quote: a supply order acknowledged from Aigle, the apothecary promising morphia and quinine on the first clear funicular

b02-diary-roeder.claim: Roeder tucks the brass-locked diary into the breast of his coat.
b02-diary-roeder.quote: The diary's brass lock caught the candlelight when he tucked it into his coat.

b02-roeder-alive.claim: Cendre meets Roeder alive on the gallery landing at ten, locking his consulting-room door.
b02-roeder-alive.quote: Cendre met him once more alive, on the gallery landing at ten

b02-roeder-ls-alive.claim: Roeder is alive the night of the storm.
b02-roeder-ls-alive.quote: It was the last she saw of him on his feet

b02-setup-diary.claim: Roeder carries a small black diary with a brass lock, the kind kept when a man does not trust his own desk.
b02-setup-diary.quote: a small black book with a brass lock, of the kind a man keeps when he does not trust his own desk

b02-setup-master-key.claim: The house master key hangs on the warden's board in Gaspard's office; Roeder keeps the only working private key on his own ring.
b02-setup-master-key.quote: the house master key, he reminded her, hung where it always hung, on the warden's board in Gaspard's office

b03-locked-room.claim: Roeder's door is bolted with his private key inside the lock; Gaspard brings the master key, cold from the board, to open it.
b03-locked-room.quote: The private key was in the lock on the inside ... the heavy old key ... was cold from the board

b04-bottle-roeder.claim: The brown bottle stands on the blotter by Roeder's dead hand.
b04-bottle-roeder.quote: near the open hand, stood a small brown medicine bottle

b04-roeder-dead.claim: Roeder is found dead at his desk, dead for hours, a brown bottle at his open hand.
b04-roeder-dead.quote: No pulse, none for hours; the jaw and the hands already set

b04-setup-vial.claim: A small brown medicine bottle, its label turned away and a third gone, stands by Roeder's open hand.
b04-setup-vial.quote: stood a small brown medicine bottle, its label turned away, perhaps a third gone

b05-chart-brandt.claim: Brandt draws the old-numbered folder from the shelf and feeds it into the consulting-room stove.
b05-chart-brandt.quote: she drew one out by its number, which she knew without reading ... and she ... fed the folder in

b05-chart-shelf.claim: The buff folders of the living are kept on the shelf at Roeder's elbow, the old case among them.
b05-chart-shelf.quote: the buff folders of the living, kept at his elbow so he might reach them without rising

b05-setup-burned-chart.claim: Alone with the body, Nurse Brandt draws a buff chart by its old number and feeds it into the consulting-room stove.
b05-setup-burned-chart.quote: she drew one out by its number, which she knew without reading ... and she ... fed the folder in

b06-helene-avenger.claim: Under the borrowed name 'Surel', the patient is the sister of a man Roeder wrote into a ledger and crossed out; she came to make him answer.
b06-helene-avenger.quote: the sister of a man who had come to Belvoir to be cured and had gone instead into the sanatorium's own ground

b06-papers-helene.claim: The forged admission papers lie in Hélène's writing-case.
b06-papers-helene.quote: In the writing-case on her knees lay the admission papers that had brought her up the mountain

b06-setup-forged-papers.claim: The patient 'Madame Hélène Surel' holds forged admission papers: a referral from a Lausanne physician who does not exist, a name that is not hers.
b06-setup-forged-papers.quote: a letter of referral from a Lausanne physician who did not exist, a name that was not her name

b07-ledger-cendre.claim: Custody of the morphine ledger passes from Roeder's authority into Cendre's keeping; she signs the foot of the page.
b07-ledger-cendre.quote: Custody passed now from Roeder's authority into Cendre's keeping

b07-ledger-roeder.claim: The green morphine ledger has lived behind Roeder's locked door, under his authority.
b07-ledger-roeder.quote: the long green morphine ledger that had lived behind his door

b07-lindqvist-alive.claim: Herr Edvard Lindqvist is alive, a wintering consumptive patient.
b07-lindqvist-alive.quote: Herr Edvard Lindqvist, a Stockholm engineer six months consumptive

b07-only-physician.claim: With the line dead and the pass shut, Cendre is the only physician on the mountain for three weeks.
b07-only-physician.quote: on the mountain exactly one person licensed to sign for a life or against it

b08-diary-cendre.claim: Cendre takes the brass-locked diary from the dead man's coat and sets it aside, to her drawer, unforced.
b08-diary-cendre.quote: she could not open it, and would not force it, and set it aside on the desk

b08-resig-roeder.claim: The unsent resignation lies under Roeder's blotter.
b08-resig-roeder.quote: The unsent letter she found under the blotter

b08-setup-resignation.claim: Roeder's unsent resignation to the Berne board breaks off: 'health' struck out, 'and of conscience' written over it and struck through, no third word.
b08-setup-resignation.quote: over it, in the same upright hand pressed harder, he had written *and of conscience,* and struck that through as well, and not found a third word

b09-boots-gaspard.claim: Gaspard finds the boots outside the sick-wing door and sets them by his office stove to dry.
b09-boots-gaspard.quote: the steward had found them outside the sick-wing door at first light and brought them in to dry

b09-setup-boots.claim: A single pair of Lindqvist's boots is found soaked through outside the sick-wing door, though Lindqvist swears he has not gone out of doors.
b09-setup-boots.quote: stood a single pair of gentleman's boots, soaked through and rimmed white with melted snow-salt

b09-setup-funicular-log.claim: The funicular maintenance log has a gap: the daily inspection signed every dawn, then nothing at all across the day before the storm.
b09-setup-funicular-log.quote: across the very day before the storm, nothing at all. No entry, no signature, no line drawn to mark the omission.

b10-setup-morphine.claim: The morphine ledger does not balance: grains entered out under Roeder's hand do not match the doses the patients' charts record receiving.
b10-setup-morphine.quote: The grains entered out did not match the grains entered back.

b10-setup-name-match.claim: A surname in the living admission register answers exactly a surname cut into the sanatorium's burial record six years before.
b10-setup-name-match.quote: A name on the register of the living that answered, exactly, a name in the book of the dead.

b10-setup-seve-change.claim: Lindqvist's chart shows a dying engineer abruptly written well a fortnight since, in Roeder's hand.
b10-setup-seve-change.quote: until a fortnight since, when in Roeder's hand the curve simply turned, and a dying engineer was abruptly written well

b11-assay.claim: Cendre assays the brown bottle: strong morphia, a mouthful enough to stop a strong heart within the hour; a third gone.
b11-assay.quote: morphia in solution, and not the timid solution one spoons to a wakeful patient

b11-bottle-cendre.claim: Cendre winds the brown bottle in lint and carries it to her own locked drawer.
b11-bottle-cendre.quote: wound it in lint, and carried it down to the locked drawer of her own room

b12-sealed.claim: The room was shut from inside: iced sash, unmarked sill, bolt drawn, master key untouched; the poison had only to arrive before the bolt.
b12-sealed.quote: The poison did not need a murderer in the room. It only needed to have arrived before the bolt.

b16-lured.claim: Gaspard remembers being called to the cable-house by a written word in a hand like Roeder's, for a fault that was not there, emptying his post the day before the storm.
b16-lured.quote: a hand that could pass for his had emptied the one office from which the mountain's one road was watched

b17-boots-cendre.claim: Cendre carries the boots up to the light and sets them in her own room with the rest of the evidence.
b17-boots-cendre.quote: She set the boots in her own room with the rest of it

b17-boots-packed.claim: The wet boots are packed at the toe with folded paper: someone with a smaller foot crossed the snow as Lindqvist.

b18-resig-cendre.claim: Cendre takes the unsent resignation up the stair into her own keeping.
b18-resig-cendre.quote: Two she took up the stair: the brass-locked diary ... and the unsent letter

b18-shape.claim: Cendre reads the shape: misconduct off the register, paid in morphia and at least one grave, and a death that closed the books on it.
b18-shape.quote: Roeder's own misconduct, and a death that closed the books on it.

b19-two-ways.claim: The ledger reads two ways: Roeder spent the morphia on his own off-book cases, or the hand that measured the doses drew more than the wards received.
b19-two-ways.quote: The discrepancy looked two ways at once and would not choose.

b20-fork.claim: Cendre must choose: confront Brandt with the ledger, or interview the patients quietly.
b20-fork.quote: Two roads lay open from the ledger, and she could walk only one of them first

b21-pay-morphine.claim: Confronted with the ledger, Brandt says the grains went where Roeder sent them: cases of his own, off the wards' books, that she carried too.
b21-pay-morphine.quote: If they did not reach the wards, Doctor, it was because he kept cases of his own — off the books you have been reading

b22-pay-burned.claim: Brandt confesses she burned a chart in his stove the morning he was found, a thing that would have shamed him and the house.
b22-pay-burned.quote: I burned a chart ... In his stove, the morning we found him.

b23-cellar.claim: The cellar archive holds no discharge of the missing folder: the earlier 'archived' account was a lie; it was burned.
b23-cellar.quote: The folder Brandt had once sent her imagination down here to find had never come down here at all.

b27-lindqvist-morphia.claim: Lindqvist's 'new strength' was the morphia's warm hour behind the private door, dressed in his chart as a cure.
b27-lindqvist-morphia.quote: She read his 'strength' for what it was — the poppy's warm hour, dressed in a chart as a cure

b28-favoured.claim: An old patient recalls that Roeder's favoured evening cases, across the winters, had a way of not lasting.
b28-favoured.quote: the favoured ones had a way of not lasting

b29-surel-coincidence.claim: Asked gently of the repeated name, Madame Surel gives a candid-shaped nothing: a wide family, a kinsman gone for the cure.
b29-surel-coincidence.quote: a kinsman, she allowed — distant; the family was wide and scattered

b34-name-noted.claim: Cendre lays register and burial book together and writes the Surel match into her notebook as a sorrow and not a suspicion.
b34-name-noted.quote: She wrote the match into her notebook as a sorrow and not a suspicion

b36-lindqvist-sinking.claim: With the evening needle stopped at Roeder's death, Lindqvist's borrowed strength drains and the true wasting coast is bared.
b36-lindqvist-sinking.quote: the borrowed strength drained back the way a tide goes

b37-diary-unforced.claim: On the quiet road Cendre cannot bring herself to force the diary; the little brass key is on no ring she can find.
b37-diary-unforced.quote: The little brass key was on neither ring she could find

b40-fork2.claim: The case forks: Hélène will either confess her name and purpose, or keep silence while a second death escalates the case.
b40-fork2.quote: a confession, or a silence with another death growing in it

b41-pay-papers.claim: Hélène confesses: her papers are forged, Surel is her own name, and the man in the ground was hers; she came to stand where he died.
b41-pay-papers.quote: My papers are forged ... The man you found in your ground was mine, Doctor.

b42-papers-cendre.claim: Hélène draws the forged papers from the writing-case and pushes them across to Cendre, who keeps them.
b42-papers-cendre.quote: drew the papers, and laid them on the table between them, and pushed them across

b42-pay-name-match.claim: Hélène names the buried Surel as her brother, spent behind the consulting-room door; she pushes the forged papers across.
b42-pay-name-match.quote: He was one of the ones taken behind the consulting-room door for the needle and the borrowed hour

b43-pay-masterkey.claim: Hélène swears she never passed the bolt; with the one hand that wished him dead outside the door, the sealed room shows its suicide face.
b43-pay-masterkey.quote: His door was bolted ... I never passed it. I set no glass by his hand.

b47-boots-again.claim: Shut out of the woman, Cendre sets the boots beside the mute witnesses: a smaller foot, an unwatched cable, an unanswered telegram — a person about the outside of the shut house.
b47-boots-again.quote: someone who had moved about the outside of this shut house near the hour it shut

b48-lindqvist-dead.claim: Lindqvist is found dead in the small hours, gone too suddenly for the slow ebb of withdrawal: a breath pinched out.
b48-lindqvist-dead.quote: Lindqvist was dead ... a breath had been pinched out rather than let run down

b48-pay-lindqvist.claim: The chart still says 'improving' in Roeder's hand: held up on a fiction and let fall, then hurried out of the world by a hand.
b48-pay-lindqvist.quote: held up on a fiction and let fall when the fiction's author died

b49-second-hand.claim: Lindqvist died in an open sickroom; a hand that could reach the second bed gives the first its missing visitor — a dose set ready before the bolt.
b49-second-hand.quote: let them lend each other a murderer

b51-pay-diary.claim: Cendre sets a thin blade to the diary's little lock and breaks it, opening Roeder's own record.
b51-pay-diary.quote: set a thin blade to the little lock, and broke it

b52-pay-morphine-diary.claim: The diary confirms the morphia, drawn under his name, went into the arms of a chosen few behind his door.
b52-pay-morphine-diary.quote: into the arms of a chosen few, behind his own door, after the wards were dark

b53-pay-boots.claim: The snow-wet boots too small for the engineer were a woman moving about the outside of the house she meant to enter.
b53-pay-boots.quote: the snow-wet boots too small for the bed-bound engineer ... A woman moving about the outside of a house

b53-pay-funicular.claim: The steward was drawn from his post by a note in a hand like Roeder's, the cable left unwatched.
b53-pay-funicular.quote: the steward drawn from his post by a note in a hand *like* Roeder's, the cable left unwatched

b53-pay-name-match.claim: Cendre sets the two Surels side by side: the buried one was Roeder's subject; the living one is kin, come for it.
b53-pay-name-match.quote: She was kin to the crossed name. She had come for it.

b53-pay-papers.claim: The papers of the woman in the lower room are forged, by someone with a reckoning to keep.
b53-pay-papers.quote: The papers in the writing-case of the woman in the lower room were forged, and forged by someone who had a reckoning to keep.

b54-pay-lindqvist.claim: Lindqvist still breathes; his improving chart was the last of Roeder's false vigours, the method's one surviving subject.
b54-pay-lindqvist.quote: Lindqvist still breathed, the improving chart over his bed the last of Roeder's false vigours

b54-pay-masterkey.claim: The master key never left its board because Roeder never meant it to; no hand reached him, for he bolted the door against every hand.
b54-pay-masterkey.quote: The master key never left its board because he never meant it to.

b54-pay-resignation.claim: The diary shows the unfinished resignation, halting on conscience, had its long rehearsal there, draft after draft.
b54-pay-resignation.quote: the unfinished resignation under his blotter, halting on the word *conscience,* had its long rehearsal here, draft after draft

b54-pay-telegram.claim: The last telegram had promised resupply only on the first clear funicular; then the line died and no more morphia was coming until the thaw.
b54-pay-telegram.quote: the last telegram up from Aigle had promised the resupply only on the first clear funicular, and then the line had died

b54-pay-vial.claim: Roeder measured himself a strong draught into the unlabelled brown bottle and drank it, bolting the door upon the world.
b54-pay-vial.quote: He had measured himself a strong draught into the unlabelled brown bottle

b55-truth-suicide.claim: Ending A: Cendre certifies death by his own hand, of a mind broken by the knowledge of his own conduct.
b55-truth-suicide.quote: Death by his own hand ... while of a mind broken by the knowledge of his own conduct

b56-pay-diary.claim: Cendre forces the diary at last: a thin blade and a steady hand, and the little mechanism gives.
b56-pay-diary.quote: A thin blade and a steady hand, and the little mechanism gave with a dry click

b57-pay-masterkey2.claim: The sealed room, the cold key and the residue all say no one had killed Augustin Roeder but Augustin Roeder.
b57-pay-masterkey2.quote: no one had killed Augustin Roeder but Augustin Roeder

b57-pay-morphine.claim: The diary shows the morphia drawn off the ledger for the evening needle and the borrowed hour.
b57-pay-morphine.quote: The morphia drawn off the ledger for the evening needle

b57-pay-resignation.claim: The diary's last pages show the resignation drafted and redrafted, always failing on the same word.
b57-pay-resignation.quote: the resignation drafted and redrafted and never finished, always failing on the same word

b57-pay-vial.claim: The diary's final entry: he had measured the strong draught into the brown bottle, meaning to drink it and bolt his door.
b57-pay-vial.quote: He had measured the strong draught into the brown bottle.

b57-truth-suicide.claim: On the confess road the death is suicide by his own conscience-dose behind the bolt.
b57-truth-suicide.quote: The man inside had drawn that bolt against the whole world and then against himself.

b58-pay-boots.claim: Hélène confesses she took the engineer's boots, packed the toes with paper, and went out in them learning the ground.
b58-pay-boots.quote: She had taken the engineer's boots from the sick-wing ... packing the toes with paper

b58-pay-funicular.claim: Hélène confesses the note that drew Gaspard to the cable-house for a fault that was not there.
b58-pay-funicular.quote: the note that drew Gaspard to the cable-house for a fault that was not there

b58-pay-telegram.claim: Hélène watched the last telegram come up and lie unanswered on the salver before the line went dead.
b58-pay-telegram.quote: she had watched the last telegram come up and lie unanswered on the salver

b59-burned-dangles.claim: On the confess road the burning of the chart stays outside Cendre's knowing: she never goes to Brandt, and the hand that took the folder is never learned.
b59-burned-dangles.quote: the burning itself stayed outside her knowing ... the one secret of the house that even this gentlest solving never reaches

b59-pay-lindqvist.claim: Lindqvist's improving chart was the method's last fiction; with the needle stopped he is failing, but alive, and Cendre will chart him honestly.
b59-pay-lindqvist.quote: Lindqvist's improving chart had been the method's last fiction ... But he was alive

b60-ending-b.claim: Ending B: Cendre certifies death by his own hand, of a conscience he could not carry, and keeps Hélène's forged papers as a survivor's testimony.
b60-ending-b.quote: death by his own hand, of a conscience he could not carry

b61-pay-masterkey.claim: The cold untouched master key, iced sash and inner bolt told her only that the killer did not need to enter.
b61-pay-masterkey.quote: They had only told her the killer did not need to enter.

b61-pay-vial.claim: The murder was laid, not committed: the dose set ready hours before in the brown bottle Roeder would lift to his own mouth.
b61-pay-vial.quote: the dose that stopped the doctor had only to be set ready, hours before, in the brown bottle

b61-truth-murder.claim: On the escalate road the death is murder: a dose composed by someone who knew Roeder's habits, set where habit would do the rest.
b61-truth-murder.quote: A dose composed by someone who knew his habits, set where habit would do the rest.

b62-pay-boots.claim: The snow-wet boots, worn through the drift by a foot too small for the man whose name they bore, are the murderer walking the snow in another's boots.
b62-pay-boots.quote: The snow-wet boots, worn through the drift by a foot too small for the man whose name they bore

b62-pay-funicular.claim: The funicular log gone blank: the steward drawn off his post by a note in a hand got up to look like Roeder's, emptying the cable-house.
b62-pay-funicular.quote: the steward drawn off his post by a note in a hand got up to look like Roeder's

b62-pay-telegram.claim: The last telegram come and gone unanswered, then the line dead and the house shut, are the movements of a single careful person.
b62-pay-telegram.quote: The last telegram come and gone unanswered, and then the line dead and the house shut

b63-burned-dangles.claim: On the escalate road Cendre sets the missing folder down to misfiling and never guesses it had gone to the stove; the burned chart's owner stays the reader's, not hers.
b63-burned-dangles.quote: the buff folder she had set down to misfiling and never guessed had gone to the stove

b63-namematch-dangles.claim: On the escalate road the buried Surel's kinship to the living patient stays the reader's and not hers; she takes the shared name for sad coincidence.
b63-namematch-dangles.quote: the buried Surel's kin ... stayed the reader's and not hers

b63-pay-morphine.claim: The ledger's missing grains fed years of the evening needle and spared a strong last dose or two for a clever hand.
b63-pay-morphine.quote: morphia enough ... to feed years of the evening needle and to spare a strong last dose or two

b64-diary-dangles.claim: On the escalate road Cendre never opens the diary; the seal holds and the case keeps its hole.
b64-diary-dangles.quote: on the escalate road she never opened it ... the case kept its hole

b64-pay-resignation.claim: The halted resignation reweighs as motive: a physician about to confess the method was one someone had reason to silence; his conscience served the hand that killed him.
b64-pay-resignation.quote: Even his conscience, in the end, had served the hand that killed him.

b65-ending-c.claim: Ending C: Cendre certifies both deaths as 'death by a hand unknown'; the murderer, Hélène, rides down unnamed and unproven.
b65-ending-c.quote: She wrote, for Roeder and for Lindqvist both, *death by a hand unknown*
